There are three shorter (1.99 Å) and three longer (2.02 Å) Ta-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two MgO₆ octahedra and corners with two TaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 28-38°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.59-1.71 Å.
